title: Chloe San Jose pens message to Carlos Yulo after world championships: 'We’re not at the finish line yet'
summary: Chloe San Jose reminds Carlos Yulo that setbacks do not define his journey after the Filipino gymnast wrapped up his campaign at the 2026 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships.
